binary: release build of main 437048f plus the sandbox run-directory fix (this commit)
worker: foundry-learn, ad-hoc-signed App Sandbox development bundle, --development-isolation; LibTorch 2.11.0 CPU, 4 threads
corpus_store: rust-lang/rust 1.99.0 refreshed 005 T003 store (revision 60741), APFS clone upgraded to schema 6

rows.round_split: per group, tasks ordered by SHA-256(task_id): first ceil(0.6 n) round 1, rest round 2 (owner decision 2026-10-05)
rows.duplicate_note: 27 composed states recur across groups (same symbol name in different modules, e.g. from_le_bytes in f16 and f64, share the query and top-3 locator lines) and 1 state carries conflicting labels; the contract refuses these as duplicate_conflict. All but the first occurrence of each, and both sides of the conflicting one, were recorded with allow_training:false through the operator CLI.

defect_found: the first sandboxed training run failed with artifact_invalid: App Sandbox moves the worker's working directory into its container, so the relative head.safetensors landed in ~/Library/Containers/org.context-foundry.learn.dev/Data. Fixed: the supervisor passes --run-dir and the worker re-enters it, confirmed by device and inode.

dataset.note: evaluation includes round 1's held-out groups: no fresh-uplift claim

reasons: accepted accuracy 0.8625 is below the floor 0.9

lifecycle.represented_input: prepare with the round-2 parent and nothing new: no_new_data, no output
lifecycle.withdrawal: withdrawing one inherited round-1 contributor (store clone): prepare refuses base_permission_changed; train refuses contribution_changed before any update
lifecycle.interruption: owner SIGKILL 30 s into a round-2 training run: worker gone 41 ms later; no candidate or partial published; incumbent manifest unchanged
lifecycle.interruption_limitation: the dead owner's scratch run directory (100 MB staged base head) is not reclaimed by later runs; removed by hand
lifecycle.select: round 1 selected (config written); round 2 refused candidate_ineligible; selecting onto an existing config refused output_exists
lifecycle.rollback: starting without a config gives deterministic routing (no route segment)

serving.cli_note: each CLI invocation pays the worker start and model load

parity.exhaustive: every element of the full gradients (34- and 1024-token cases) and the post-sequence parameters within atol 1e-5 / rtol 1e-4 (16 s, release)

interpretation: Round 1 is eligible by the predeclared floors on 71 held-out rows (+1 row over deterministic routing); that permits a trial, not an improvement claim. Round 2 is a valid rejected candidate. The fitted temperature sits at the grid's upper edge (3.0). The learned router stays off by default (owner decision: no paid enablement comparison).
